title: Maratha Military Landscapes & UNESCO World Heritage Conservation
prelims_pointers: Maratha Military Landscapes include hill, coastal, and sea forts showcasing medieval engineering.

mains_perspective.context: Balancing heritage tourism promotion with structural preservation.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Forts serve as testaments to indigenous defensive strategies under Shivaji Maharaj.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Adopt scientific stone consolidation and community-based heritage management.

title: Temple Architecture Styles: Nagara, Dravida & Vesara Evolution
prelims_pointers: Nagara style features beehive-shaped towers (Shikhara) common in northern India.
Dravida style is characterized by pyramidal towers (Vimana) and monumental gateways (Gopurams) in southern India.

mains_perspective.context: Understanding religious architecture as a reflection of socio-political patronage.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Temple complexes served not only as places of worship but as economic hubs and employers.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Promote digital archiving of temple inscriptions to prevent archaeological degradation.

title: Cooperative Federalism vs. Aggressive Fiscal Centralization
prelims_pointers: Inter-State Council operates under Article 263 as a recommendatory body.
GST Council is a constitutional body under Article 279A.
Sarkaria and Punchhi Commissions examined the strengthening of cooperative federalism.

mains_perspective.context: Rising friction between the Union and states over cess/surcharges and Governor's role.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Excessive reliance on cesses dilutes the divisible pool of taxes under Finance Commission recommendations.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Institutionalize regular meetings of the Inter-State Council and adhere strictly to Sarkaria Commission guidelines.

title: India's Three-Stage Nuclear Power Programme & Civil Liability
prelims_pointers: Stage I uses PHWRs; Stage II uses Fast Breeder Reactors (FBR); Stage III utilizes Thorium-Uranium-233 cycle.
Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act (CLNDA), 2010 mandates operator liability.

mains_perspective.context: Expanding base-load clean energy capacity to meet net-zero targets.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: India possesses world-class thorium reserves, making Stage III critical for long-term energy security.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Foster public-private research partnerships and streamline nuclear insurance frameworks.

title: Inclusive Growth, K-Shaped Recovery & Agrarian Distress
prelims_pointers: MSME sector contributes nearly 30% to India's GDP and 40% to exports.
PM-KISAN provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families.

mains_perspective.context: Macroeconomic GDP growth numbers outpacing wage growth and rural consumption recovery.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: High corporate profitability coexists with stagnant rural wages and high youth unemployment.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Shift focus from capital-intensive manufacturing subsidies to labor-intensive sectors.

title: Bureaucratic Ethics, Lateral Entry & Whistleblower Protection
prelims_pointers: Second ARC 4th Report focuses extensively on ethics in governance.
Whistleblowers Protection Act provides legal mechanisms to safeguard informants.

mains_perspective.context: Navigating the tension between political executive directives and professional neutrality.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Anonymity and neutrality are often compromised by systemic political pressure.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Implement 2nd ARC recommendations and establish Civil Services Boards for transparent postings.
